correctness.rationale: Pass for the magnitude table normalized by n!, and for the rank of the restriction, not the full operator. Relative order on the active vertices is uniform; disconnected internal relative orders are independent. Reversal in an odd-edge component negates its sign, leaving only P3 in degree two and P3 disjoint P3 as the disconnected degree-four survivor. The connected degree-four shapes are exhausted by the two four-vertex graphs and the three five-vertex trees. The last-vertex recurrence signs precisely the new inversions. Independently, representing ranks by iid uniform variables gives the same even moments: P3 and K1,4 integrate (1-2u)^2 and (1-2u)^4; conditioning on two vertices on one side of C4 gives the integral of (1-2|u-v|)^2; for the fork the integrand is (1-2u)^2(1-2|u-v|), and for P5 it is (1-2u)(1-2v)(1-2|u-v|). Their evaluations are respectively 1/3,1/5,1/3,1/15,2/15 under suitable reference orientations. The triangle with pendant edge is zero by swapping the two triangle vertices other than the attachment. A separate exact enumeration of all supports through degree four and orders on n=4,5,6 returned the stated degree counts. Counting the paths, cycles, five-vertex labeled trees and pairs of three-vertex paths gives 3,3,125,90 on their corresponding vertex sets, proving the rank polynomial, including n=3 with binomial convention.
residual_risks: Reference labelings can change signs; the table asserts magnitudes, not those specific canonical signs. Finite replay is not an extrapolation to larger degree.

evidence: The dyadic Fourier entry gives a universal 2^(n-s_2(n)) divisor of the very same signed sums and reversal-forced zeros.

The Chebikin–Postnikov introductory inversion statistic is on rooted labeled trees and its -1 specialization counts alternating permutations; it is not the parity moment on a fixed frequency graph. A thesis with the exact chromatic quasisymmetric q=-1 specialization was located but its contents were not lawfully retrieved in the bounded attempts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Divisibility supplies no distinction between zero and nonzero among even motifs of the same size and does not give their exact magnitudes. The thesis is a substantive possible stronger theorem, not a basis for a whole-document negative assertion.

originality.rationale: The supported distinct result is the complete low-degree Walsh support classification, values and restriction-rank polynomial, not the inversion statistic, component factorization, odd-degree zeros, two-edge covariance or isolated star evaluation. The literature has a genuinely equivalent invariant: a fixed-label chromatic quasisymmetric squarefree coefficient at q=-1. One published table already supplies the five-vertex star value, and the indexed incidence law supplies the two-edge value, so these are credited as prior coverage. The inspected general definitions and specific tables do not supply all surviving and vanishing fourth-degree shapes and the resulting rank.
residual_risks: The Liu thesis is the strongest inaccessible specialized source and could contain additional evaluated cases or a stronger formula. Full text for the two earlier catalogue records was not retrieved. An inaccessible source is not evidence of absence; the originality judgment is limited to the complete classification beyond the verified partial coverage.

value.rationale: Degree four is the first even band where connected cycles and several distinct tree shapes can occur, and the first with a nonzero product of two nonconstant components. The precise list and multiplicities identify which four-way order-comparison moments survive and give the dimension retained by low-degree XOR convolution on this natural ranking set. This is a full all-n invariant for the first such band, not an arbitrary set of small ambient n or a recomputation of the known star and covariance alone.
residual_risks: No full Fourier rank, conditioning behavior or higher-degree classification is established.
